dedupe_keys.name: global gridded real gdp and electricity consumption 1992 2019

description: This research deposit provides global gridded revised real gross domestic product and electricity consumption for 1992–2019 at one-kilometre resolution. Its own title identifies calibrated nighttime lights as the basis, while Figshare offers separate GDP and electricity ZIP packages. A companion Figshare deposit, 19517272, publishes PSO-BP code for relating national GDP to nighttime lights as a Word document. Both deposits state CC BY 4.0 with free access. The paired layers can distribute economic activity and electricity demand across simulation regions, complementing future scenarios in data-global-gridded-gdp-ssp and observational proxies in data-nasa-black-marble-night-lights. A caveat is that gridded estimates derived from a light proxy do not measure each cell's electricity use directly. The own landing pages do not establish all internal raster formats, units or missing-value conventions. The companion code document may require manual extraction and environment reconstruction before use. No archives or document were downloaded, and no regional totals were recalculated.
